name: Rebase
description: Rebase is an open-source backend for PostgreSQL: REST API, auth, realtime, storage, cron and an admin panel, with row-level security enforced by Postgres. This template starts it with no code: open /_studio on your domain, sign in with the generated admin account, and every table you create there is served at once.
seoDescription: Open-source Postgres backend with REST, auth, realtime, storage and an admin panel. Self-host Rebase on Dokploy in a few clicks.
